This small plot is just behind my house, less than a quarter of my land. I plant maize with cowpea between the rows like my father did. I have no money to buy a full bag of fertilizer for such a small piece, so I will put the goat and chicken droppings I have collected. I keep my own seed from last harvest — improved seed from the agro-dealer costs money I do not have, and my neighbors here plant the same local maize.
